faces.name: Djeru, With Eyes Open
faces.oracle_text:
Vigilance
When Djeru enters, you may search your library for a planeswalker card, reveal it, put it into your hand, then shuffle.
If a source would deal damage to a planeswalker you control, prevent 1 of that damage.
